title: Error Compiling Dev branch
symptom: When compiling the dev branch of AndroidAPS with Android Studio, the nsClientRelease variant fails with error: Task 'assembleNsclientRelease' not found in project ':app'. Some candidates are: 'assembleAapsclientRelease'. The fullRelease variant compiles fine.
cause: The nsclientRelease is an old name; the dev branch uses aapsclientRelease.
fix: Clone the project, switch to dev branch, and sync the project in Android Studio so that the aapsclient variant appears.
evidence_quote: nsclientRelease is old name. Dev is using aapsclientRelease
